_comment: Case-insensitive substrings matched against PackageName and DisplayName of packages actually found via 'dism /Get-ProvisionedAppxPackages' in the mounted image (see core/appx_cleaner.py). Only packages present in the specific edition being customized will actually be removed. Edit freely - no code change needed. NOT included: modern (Chromium) Edge and OneDrive, which are Win32 installs rather than provisioned Appx packages and cannot be removed via this mechanism.
